_comment: Remote brokers this one may delegate a role to. Copy to upstreams.json (gitignored -- it holds tokens) and edit. Hot-read: adding a box takes effect on the next request, no restart.
_syntax: A role then names one with a DOUBLE colon, e.g. "openmaic": "offsite::mistral-small3*:24b". Doubled because a single colon is already the model/tag separator -- gemma3:4b would otherwise parse as upstream 'gemma3'. The glob is resolved by the UPSTREAM, against its own inventory, not this box's.
_note: 'local' is implicit and cannot be redefined here. An unregistered name in a role value is NOT silently run locally: it stays whole, matches nothing, and shows as a missing chip -- better than quietly using the wrong box.
